rapport_notes: Extremely patient and flexible through a chaotic, multi-interruption call (a daughter joining live, the whole schedule renegotiated mid-call).
process_discipline_notes: Being 'bonded and insured' was answered directly in Stage 1 in response to her top concern, then repeated as the 'no worries damage coverage' differentiator in the Stage 2 pricing pitch.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and what are the most important things you'd like to get answers to on this call today?' — asked before any address/inventory probing (only date and name had been collected)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'we are definitely bonded... we have professionally trained movers who will take care of your move, it's a, it's ours' — a direct reassurance to her insurance concern, but no follow-up question
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we have a two and a half hour minimum and once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments'

top_strength: Extremely patient and accommodating handling of a chaotic, multi-interruption call while still delivering an accurate personalized estimate and live schedule change.
coaching_note: The 'bonded and insured' reassurance covers the same ground as the later damage-coverage pitch — connect them explicitly instead of repeating cold, and dig one layer deeper on the insurance question rather than a single reassurance.
